fn records() -> Vec<serde_json::Value> {
    RECORDS
        .as_bytes()
        .lines()
        .map(|line| line.expect("a fixture line"))
        .filter(|line| !line.trim().is_empty())
        .map(|line| serde_json::from_str(&line).expect("the fixture is JSON"))
        .collect()
}
